page_title: Vector Graphic Design Software for Mac, iPad and iPhone – Amadine

sources.entry: Amadine - Vector drawing app with an intuitive interface for graphic designers.

summary.name: Amadine
summary.one_liner: Amadine is a vector graphic design app for Mac, iPad and iPhone for drawing logos, illustrations and UI/website layouts.
use_cases: website and UI layout precise positioning
exporting graphics to SVG, PDF, EPS, PNG or JPEG
summary.what_it_does: Amadine is a vector drawing application with an interface described as intuitive and quick to work in. It offers circular text, text on path and text in shape, plus custom vector lettering, for building logos. Precision tools include Pixel Preview, Snap to Grid, Snap to Pixel and Smart Guides for web and UI layouts. It supports a CMYK color mode for print work and exports to SVG, PDF, EPS, TIFF, PNG and JPEG, including on iPhone.
notable: Text on path, circular text and text in shape for logo work
CMYK color mode with SVG, PDF, EPS, TIFF, PNG and JPEG export
Pixel Preview, Snap to Pixel and Smart Guides for precise layouts
Free trial available; lifetime license offered
caveats: Mac version has a 30 day money back guarantee only when purchased from the official website; App Store returns follow App Store policy
Requires macOS 11 or higher, iPadOS or iOS 15 or higher
